_comment: Analyst summary sources (Stage 7 #16). Paths and roles only; nearly all are TEST data (config/test_set.json, D35 eval): tools/build_summary.py refuses without ARENA_GO. The catalog follows the #16 plan (designer may cut or add). Labels and baselines are reader-facing (no internal ids, milestone or decision numbers; designer 2026-11-24): the analyst names experiments by label; ids stay in the evidence-manifest appendix.
